title: NFL has grand expectations for SoFi Stadium's first 'full-on' Super Bowl

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: NFL has grand expectations for SoFi Stadium's first 'full-on' Super Bowl
sources.description: In February 2027, SoFi Stadium will play host to Super Bowl LXI, and the NFL is excited about the possibilities after the stadium's first Super Bowl was limited by COVID restrictions.
